A UAE presidential Boeing 787 flew home from Rabat today on a long detour over Turkey and Iraq, avoiding Egyptian and Saudi airspace.

With no Israeli planes landing in Morocco lately, it may be how Israel's Defense Ministry director general got there.

https://t.co/dKdpP7dh0x

🚨 The IRGC says a third oil tanker was hit in the Strait of Hormuz today.

It claims the "violating" tanker struck a sea mine this afternoon and boasts that even American F 35 jets could not protect the ships. No independent confirmation yet. https://t.co/Z3Kxs31vrE

Egypt's new terror listing comes just 24 hours after Cairo permanently designated the Muslim Brotherhood a terrorist group.

That move also added three people to the list and ended the old temporary three year designations that needed renewal. https://t.co/XRYGVk3O1x

JD Vance on impeaching Pete Hegseth: "The question is absurd and the answer is: obviously not."

He says lawmakers are angriest where Hegseth is most right, pulling forces back from Europe and Ukraine and reshaping the generals. "This isn't about Iran."

Russia claims its first official interception of the US made AGM 188A Rusty Dagger.

Its Defense Ministry says four of the cruise missiles were downed in the last day. The missile is a Zone 5 Technologies design built for the US Air Force ERAM program. https://t.co/QbESR3fqjm
Syrian reconnaissance teams have visited Saudi Arabia and Yemen ahead of a possible deployment to support the Saudi war against the Houthis, officials say. No final decision has been made.

A Syrian army fighter in Idlib shows off a painted AR carbine fitted with a homemade suppressor.

The Turkish made Kalekalıp KCR556 was produced in 2026 for Syria's Interior Ministry, with all manufacturer markings removed. https://t.co/pMLofkOjV5

The IDF says it struck several targets across Gaza today, including a Hamas tunneling commander who once held hostages, operatives at a weapons production site, and a company commander in Shejaiya. https://t.co/8ILRfAavKF

🚨 Egypt has put 35 entities on its terrorism list for five years, including major Muslim groups across Europe.

Among them: the Council of European Muslims, Muslims of France, the Muslim Association of Britain and the European Council for Fatwa and Research. https://t.co/Oj3erbstE8

Netanyahu goes further on Iran:

"The only way to eliminate the Iranian threat forever is to topple the ayatollah's regime."

Trump and new White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller are fully backing War Secretary Pete Hegseth, CNN reports.

In private talks with Hegseth and senior officials, both signaled they will, for now, firmly oppose any effort to remove him.
🚨 War Secretary Pete Hegseth says 18 Americans have died in Operation Epic Fury, the US military campaign against Iran.

A NATO RQ 4D Phoenix surveillance drone, callsign MAGMA10, is flying over the Black Sea while squawking 7600, the code for lost radio contact.

Flight data shows it is operated by the Italian Air Force and cruising at about 52,000 feet. https://t.co/VTZcm3AHYp

🚨 Russia claims it destroyed a cargo ship in the Black Sea.

According to the claim, the vessel was carrying weapons and military equipment for Ukraine. There is no independent confirmation yet.

Netanyahu sounds the alarm on Iran:

"In the very near future, we will face international pressure to accept a nuclear Iran."

Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei calls the US response "deceptive." Tehran sent its seven conditions and the first US reply fell short, he says.

He called US claims of talks and a Qatar meeting pure lies, and denied any planned meeting with JD Vance.

🚨 UKMTO warning 201/26: a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile 19 nautical miles northeast of Lima, Oman, at 1338 UTC today.

The crew are safe and there is no environmental impact. Ships are urged to transit with caution. https://t.co/2mK7jQTjw1

Trump says Israel and the Gulf states shielded by US forces in the Iran war will pay back every dollar it cost, naming Israel for the first time.

Gulf governments say they were never told of Washington's plans and took the brunt of Iran's retaliation. https://t.co/OxyHwSP7eU

Iranian Artesh and IRGC officers have been running military training for "Janfada" volunteer units.

The units trained with Dehlavieh anti tank guided missiles, FPV drones, MASAF 2 rifles and a rare US made M4A1 carbine fitted with an M203 grenade launcher. https://t.co/0u32kT0RTa

🚨 ADNOC Logistics and Services confirms one of its vessels was damaged in an attack in UAE territorial waters in the Arabian Gulf this afternoon.

Response efforts are ongoing, and the company says more updates will follow. https://t.co/s9l7PF8wRU
